mapper.insert: insert into integration_connections(tenant_id,connection_id,provider_type,connection_name,owner_department_id,owner_group_id,base_url,deployment_type,provider_version,status,timeout_ms,retry_policy_id,rate_limit_policy_id,tls_policy_id,enabled,version,created_at,updated_at) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.connectionId},#{value.providerType},#{value.connectionName},#{value.ownerDepartmentId},#{value.ownerGroupId},#{value.baseUrl},#{value.deploymentType},#{value.providerVersion},#{value.status},#{value.timeoutMs},#{value.retryPolicyId},#{value.rateLimitPolicyId},#{value.tlsPolicyId},#{value.enabled},#{value.version},#{value.createdAt},#{value.updatedAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,connection_id) do update set connection_name=excluded.connection_name,owner_department_id=excluded.owner_department_id,owner_group_id=excluded.owner_group_id,base_url=excluded.base_url,status=excluded.status,enabled=excluded.enabled,version=excluded.version,updated_at=excluded.updated_at
